title: MEND generates Mirror edit codes
hypothesis: For edit requests whose weight updates lie in a shared two-matrix subspace, an editor that maps low-rank gradient signals to two Mirror coordinates will retain held-out edit RMSE <=0.05 and locality RMSE <=0.05 while using <=0.75x actual edit-system bytes of a MEND-style full-update generator; direct native low-rank generation and analytic rank-one edit controls test attribution.
physical_object: one frozen 6x6 linear model plus two shared edit-update basis matrices
mirror_coordinate: two-value edit code generated from a low-rank support-gradient signal
logical_multiplicity: 20 logical edited models from one shared base and compact edit addresses; 4 edit requests are held out from editor training
controls: MEND-style editor maps flattened support gradient to full 6x6 update
same two-code generator plus shared update basis as direct native low-rank alias
analytic rank-one ROME-style update from the edit support
independent full update fit from each edit support as quality upper

task.type: synthetic linear model editing with support keys and residual targets; target updates lie in a seeded shared two-matrix subspace

development.selection_metric: heldout edit RMSE plus locality RMSE, actual full edit-system bytes and edit-generation latency

paid_objects: MEND full per-edit updates or Mirror per-edit codes/shared basis
ROME update factors or independent matrices

compute.mac_proxy_formula: Application D^2; learned editor D^2*32 + 32*out_dim; Mirror additionally 2*D^2 basis decode; out_dim=36 for MEND and 2 for Mirror/native-lowrank. Generation proxy includes editor/decode plus one application. Support-derived controls include only one application per generated edit; their support-fit operation proxy is separately recorded.

gates.PROMISING: Both seeds: heldout edit RMSE <=0.05, locality RMSE <=0.05, Mirror actual payload <=0.75x MEND, edit MAC proxy <=1.25x MEND, and direct native low-rank control does not exactly match Mirror payload/output.
gates.FAIL: Either seed misses a PROMISING clause or direct native low-rank generation exactly aliases Mirror.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent support-fit upper has heldout edit RMSE >0.025 or locality RMSE >0.05 in either seed, or payload/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic linear edit mechanism, not a MEND reproduction or factual language-model editing result.
Sixteen requests train the editor; four heldout edit requests are generated from support only and do not tune the editor.
The independent support-fit upper must pass a strict quality validity check before capacity or edit-quality conclusions.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless every frozen PROMISING gate passes.
